title: Milken Institute Santa Monica office at 1250 Fourth Street
summary: Milken Institute's official contact page lists 1250 Fourth Street, Santa Monica, CA 90401 as its Los Angeles office. Its current LinkedIn organization profile labels Santa Monica as headquarters and the same street as the primary location; a Bloomberg LEI record also reports the street as headquarters but the LEI registration is lapsed. The record therefore preserves office and reported-headquarters semantics separately.
